title: Agent proposals churn
story: Agents write drafts and proposals at 5x the human rate, most discarded.
checked: Proposals never leak into decisions; pulls at a basis see exactly what was committed.

witnesses.positive: subjects with at least one accepted proposal (the person's decision changes the I-9)
witnesses.negative: idle subjects; also, database-side, no I-9 ever carries a proposal attribute

domain: proposals never count as decisions (W0 rule; O-DOMAIN)

oracle.source: O-REPLAY (pulls read placement, worker and I-9; the proposal entity is outside the pull)

rungNote: Sized for a shared 2-CPU dev slot (measured 2026-11-07: about 0.1 to 1 commits/s under pinned readers): the rung is the 10k-subject background world; the live phase runs the fixed trace (15 facts/s, open loop) with a scaled scenario overlay. Year-one volumes wait for PLAN section 8 order 6.
